factorized_exact_enumeration.purpose: Avoid materializing millions of redundant configuration records while preserving an exact finite universe.
factorized_exact_enumeration.equivalence: When the configuration universe is exactly the Cartesian product of independently frozen factor sets under a pure bijective merge mapping, equality of the factor sets plus equality of the mapping proves equality of the full configuration set without storing every member simultaneously.

gate_a_requirement: A factorized exact universe is fully frozen only after the independent factor-set parity receipt, factorized descriptor root, management overlay parity, execution/stress profile freeze, post-expansion RISE fixed point and config-hash freeze receipt all PASS.
anti_shortcut: Factorization is a storage/execution optimization only. It must not reduce dimensions, omit cells, sample configurations or replace exact enumeration with estimates.
